## Problem and behavior

Explain the problem, the resulting behavior, and any compatibility or privacy impact.

## Verification

- [ ] `bun run check` passes.
- [ ] Relevant regressions cover observable behavior with synthetic data.
- [ ] Documentation describes new configuration or limitations.
- [ ] No credentials, private transcripts or generated bundles are included.

For adapter changes, list manual Claude checks and versions, or state which
checks you could not perform. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
